title: Exact reservation and capacity acceptance evidence domain

decision.boundary: Represent one immutable caller-supplied positive acceptance assertion for one exact FOOD-005D reservation-request version as associated with one exact FOOD-005E physical-order version.
whyNow: FOOD-005D creates reservation-request and capacity-demand truth only.
FOOD-005D explicitly requires a separately trusted reservation/capacity acceptance seam before held-capacity truth may be consumed downstream.
FOOD-005E retains exact reservation-request snapshots but explicitly does not invent acceptance.
No canonical positive reservation/capacity acceptance record currently exists.
decision.trustedSourceBoundary: The pure domain validates exact structure, snapshots and source binding only. It does not authenticate the accepting operator/service and does not itself perform the atomic stock/slot reservation. A later trusted service must create acceptance only after its authoritative reservation operation succeeds.
decision.historicalBoundary: Acceptance may be recorded against an exact requested or cancelled physical-order version as historical evidence. It does not revive a cancelled order.
decision.notInventoryLedger: The accepted capacity requirements are copied evidence of what was accepted. FOOD-005L does not decrement stock, create quantity-on-hand, mutate slot inventory, release capacity or implement race control.
decision.notReadiness: Acceptance alone does not create checkout readiness, payment readiness, preparation authority, dispatch readiness or fulfillment authority.

contract.requestBinding: Exact FOOD-005D reservation-request ID/version copied by that physical-order version.
contract.fulfillmentBinding: Exact FOOD-005D fulfillment-intent ID/version plus method, locationReference and windowReference.
contract.capacityBinding: Exact immutable SKU ID/version/quantity requirements from the reservation request.

acceptanceMetadata.sourceReference: Caller supplied opaque bounded provenance reference.

contract.immutability: Returned record and all nested snapshots are detached and frozen.

invariants: cancelled order + historical acceptance evidence != revived order

future.trustedService: A later authoritative capacity service performs atomic inventory/slot reservation and creates FOOD-005L acceptance evidence only after success.
future.readiness: A later readiness projection may combine exact non-cancelled order truth, trusted reservation acceptance, payable truth and other independent gates without mutating any source history.
future.cancellation: Later operational services may release held capacity after cancellation; FOOD-005L remains immutable historical evidence.
